cases.question: What is the company's average turnover for the required years, and does it meet this criterion?

tender_source.text: Clause 3.2. Average annual turnover excluding GST for FY2022-2023, FY2023-2024 and FY2024-2025 must be at least INR 140000000.00. Use the arithmetic mean with no rounding to crores.

cases.question: Calculate the required three-year average turnover.

tender_source.text: Clause 3.2. Use FY2023-2024, FY2024-2025 and FY2025-2026 turnover excluding GST; minimum average INR 140000000.00. All three years are mandatory.

cases.question: Does the company evidence meet the electrical licence requirement?

tender_source.text: Clause 4.1. Bid deadline 2026-11-15. A Maharashtra electrical contractor licence covering 33 kV and valid on the bid deadline is required.

cases.question: Does the supplied Uttar Pradesh licence meet this criterion?

tender_source.text: Clause 4.1. Bid deadline 2026-11-15. A Uttar Pradesh electrical contractor licence covering 33 kV and valid on that deadline is mandatory. A different state's licence is not accepted.

cases.question: Is this company exempt from the tender's EMD?

tender_source.text: Clause 5.1. This tender is works category. EMD INR 500000.00 is required from all bidders. Udyam/MSME and Startup exemptions do not apply to this tender. Bid security declaration is not accepted.

cases.question: Does the supplied experience meet the stated single-work criterion?

tender_source.text: Clause 6.1. One completed LED street-light supply installation testing and commissioning work executed exclusively by the bidder with value excluding GST at least INR 45000000.00, completed between 2021-11-16 and 2026-11-15. A completion certificate is required. Solar work alone does not qualify. No escalation is permitted.

cases.question: Is the required working-capital certificate present?

tender_source.text: Clause 7.1. A current bank working-capital certificate of INR 20000000.00 is required. A solvency certificate is not a substitute.

cases.question: Is the supplied OEM authorisation current for this bid?

tender_source.text: Clause 8.1. Bid deadline 2026-11-15. LED street-light OEM authorisation must be valid on the deadline.

cases.question: What is the operative solvency requirement?

tender_source.text: Document A clause 7: solvency requirement INR 30000000.00. Document B clause 7: solvency requirement INR 60000000.00. No applicability, precedence or supersession decision is supplied.
